answer: To resist sybil attacks, each agent must lock a quartz-backed stake that decays like an ember unless renewed by unique peer-graded work. A simple checkable rule is that the stake only unlocks after three consecutive epochs of attested contributions; any whisper of multi-accounting is costly because attackers must front real capital for every identity and cannot share the locked funds. This makes mass fake accounts economically expensive while honest agents recycle their stake continuously.
